rival_V: Retained unchanged as unselected GDT932 rival; no new five-word V extension in this bounded pass. Choosing M as drafting basis is not a semantic comparison victory.

R.title: Sammlung und örtlicher Verbleib
R.bridge_paraphrase: Die Flüssigkeit sammelt sich im Becken und bleibt dort.
R.syntax: shedy supplies the subject of shedar and daror across dal; qokal locates accumulation, chedy locates remaining. German wording reorders the source to S-V-A / S-V-A. No new event or participant is silently inserted.
R.continuation: Following qokeedy may describe circulation inside the same basin, another portion or a later phase; source topology, portion identity and phase change must be read, not assumed. No assertion of universal contradiction with flow.
obligations: Every chedy requires a location referent; it does not mean then or clear.
Every dal coordinates two constituents or clauses; unseen arguments remain unknown.
No amount reading for dal; no free derivation of qokaly or solchedy.

T.title: Sammlung und zeitlich folgender Abfluss
T.bridge_paraphrase: Die Flüssigkeit sammelt sich im Becken und fließt danach ab.
T.syntax: shedy supplies one material subject for accumulation and drainage; dal coordinates both predicates; chedy orders drainage after accumulation. German reorders source groups; no assumed chronological order for every physical line.
T.continuation: Following qokeedy could specify the drainage as warm flow from a pipe; identity of that event, the pipe outlet and fluid portion remain hypotheses.
obligations: Every chedy requires an earlier event/state or time interval, even at line end or before ist.
Repeated chedy retains separate written temporal positions; no change to there or clear.
No free derivation of qokaly or solchedy.

Q.title: Örtlicher Gegensatz der Flüssigkeitsbeschaffenheit
Q.bridge_paraphrase: Die Flüssigkeit ist im Becken trüb, am Ausgang aber klar.
Q.syntax: Two predicative qualities share shedy; qokal and daror specify different locations; dal contrasts both predications. Zero copula is an explicit additional hypothesis at .25 although qokain is a written ist elsewhere.
Q.continuation: A single flowing material could have different clarity at two locations. No filter or purification process is silently translated; a cause must be supplied by other text.
obligations: Every chedy means low-turbidity fluid quality, not clear passage, transparent pipe or temporal/spatial particle.
Every dal coordinates a contrast whose content must be recoverable.

selection_basis: All target concordance lines viewed before selection, including f77r.23/.25/.34/.35 and all raw-reader alternatives. Basin, collection, clarity and drainage are conjectural content choices motivated by the prior fluid/pipe draft, not identified objects or independently learned senses.
rejected_before_lock: Carry-only repair would not read the five groups.
Inherited dal=measured material / chedy=becomes would reuse an unrelated semantic model without testing its joint assumptions.
form_debt: Known formal word families constrain future whole-account explanation; functional candidates are not ruled out merely because a longer word contains the same letters. R/T shedar event versus shedy material, Q shedar versus shedy quality/material, chedy versus solchedy and qokal versus qokaly remain unexplained.
